description: The nanoframe ladder: ARM solars at 5, 25, 50, 75 and 95 % built in a row on open Two Continents ground, a lab at 40 % and a Stumpy at 60 % beside them, all owned by player 0 so nothing fires; a CORE spare far off keeps the game alive. Every stage of the engine's build-state recolour (build-state.md §3, stages A to E) is on screen at once, and so is the wireframe that runs through all of them. The units are created complete and then have +0x104 written, so pause (or read a frame quickly): a nanoframe nobody is building stays at its percentage, but compare stages rather than a live build's history.
